name: Security review
objective: Continuously review scoped code changes for security risks, validate findings with evidence, and escalate sensitive decisions to humans.

trigger.cadence_or_event: PRs touching auth, permissions, infrastructure, dependencies, cryptography, or data handling; plus a weekly pass on active branches.

intake.selection_rule: Review security-relevant diffs only; validate every finding against concrete code paths before reporting it.

workspace.isolation: Read-only exploration by default; safe fixtures only for proof-of-concept checks.

agents.responsibility: Map attack surfaces and sensitive changes in the diff.
Check for vulnerability classes and missing controls.
Distinguish exploitable findings from speculative concerns.
Decide whether to open a narrow PR, file an issue, or escalate.

gates: findings cite concrete files, paths, inputs, or traces
static analysis or tests support claims where possible
suggested fixes do not weaken controls or broaden permissions

state.update_rule: Record the reviewed SHA, findings, false positives, and human decisions after each review target.

escalation.destination: Private security triage channel, never a public issue

exit.success: High-confidence findings are reported with evidence, or no evidence-backed issues remain.
exit.stop_without_success: Validation retries are exhausted or the next step requires human approval.
